nodes.text: @pappybest What will it take? It's coming - Covid precautions have been reinstated in a part of India amid rising alarm over the so-called "mystery illness": HMPV, which exhibits symptoms similar to those of COVID-19.  Indian state of Karnataka is also taking precautionary measures.
